maml:description.maml:para: Allows you to specify whether the given key is either an 'Extension' key or a 'License' key. By default the value is License.

This allows you to activate license or extend evaluation of a server that has no internet connection. When this switch is used, the command generates an "Activation Request Code URL" or "Evaluation Extension Request Code URL". Copy this URL to another computer with Internet access, open that URL to obtain "Activation Authorization Code" or "Evaluation Extension Authorization Code". Copy that Authorization Code to this computer and complete your activation or evaluation extension by running the following command;
Register-NCache -AuthCode paste-copied-authorization-code-here -OfflineActivate

command:example.maml:title: -------------------------- Example 1 --------------------------

maml:introduction.maml:paragraph: The following command activates NCache using NCache license key on local server with 'production' environment.

command:example.dev:code: Register-NCache -Key xxxxxxxx-xxxxxx-xxxxxxxx -FirstName Paul -LastName Jones -Email paul.jones@alachisoft.com -Company alachisoft -Environment production

dev:remarks.maml:para: This command registers NCache on local server with the given NCache license key for environment 'production'.

command:example.maml:title: -------------------------- Example 2 --------------------------

maml:introduction.maml:paragraph: The following command activates NCache using NCache license key on server 20.200.21.11 with 'production' environment.

command:example.dev:code: Register-NCache -Key xxxxxxxx-xxxxxx-xxxxxxxx -FirstName Paul -LastName Jones -Email paul.jones@alachisoft.com -Company alachisoft -Server 20.200.21.11 -Environment production

dev:remarks.maml:para: This command registers NCache on server 20.200.21.11 with the given NCache license key for environment 'production'.

command:example.maml:title: -------------------------- Example 3 --------------------------

maml:introduction.maml:paragraph: The following command reactivates NCache using NCache license key on already activated machine on server 20.200.21.11 for 'production' environment.

command:example.dev:code: Register-NCache -Key xxxxxxxx-xxxxxx-xxxxxxxx -FirstName Paul -LastName Jones -Email paul.jones@alachisoft.com -Company alachisoft -Server 20.200.21.11 -Reactivate -Environment production

dev:remarks.maml:para: This command reactivates NCache on already activated machine using NCache license key for environment 'production'.

command:example.maml:title: -------------------------- Example 4 --------------------------

maml:introduction.maml:paragraph: This command returns the URL for registering NCache offline using NCache license key.
